conbody.p: On a computer, click a card to open it beside the board: the board gives it room and stays in view, so you can go from card to card. The open mark at a card's corner, or in the open card's header, opens the card in full, wide in the middle of the window. On a phone a card opens over the board. Either way the card lets you:

ul.li: See linked artifacts (from the artifact IDs) with links into the Requirements view.
